_about: T1190: what the visible-text method keeps but cannot judge (the kinds in extract_synopsis.GATED_UNSURE) on a PDF page that holds rows, accepted by the owner after he has looked at the page, FOR ONE BOOK. Each item {pdf_sha256, pdf_page, kind, text, note} is matched on all four of the first: accepted for one book, a hit is NEW in another. Read by extract_synopsis (the run's one [unsure] line names any hit not here as NEW) and by the T426 gate (--check-against and `baseline check` fail on a NEW one). Pages without rows are not gated: their hits stay `[visible]` notes. Only the owner adds an item; an agent reports the hit instead.
